newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat lower amid karnal bunt find.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat lower amid karnal bunt find.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures set new contract lows early after karnal bunt fungus was detected in Tennessee wheat and amid an increase in farmer-related hedging, traders said.
"Karnal bunt got us lower. Along with that, the spread's falling apart," a MGE trader said.
Atwood-Peavey had sold close to two million bushels of December wheat, and traders linked this to an increase in farmer sales of wheat.
At 1022 CST, MGE spring wheat was 3-1/4 to 6-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with December down 6-3/4 cents at $3.91-1/2.
Earlier, Dec set a new contract low at $3.89, down 9-1/4 cents on the day.
Traders said Continental bought one million Dec bushels. Wilson and LFG each bought around 500,000 Dec, they said.
